calibration_sources: Meta Llama-3 16,384-GPU Cluster Operations & Grey Failure / Straggler Telemetry Studies
ByteDance MegaScale (10,000+ GPU Production Training: Straggler Attribution & Dynamic Load Balancing)
NVIDIA NVRx / Resiliency Extension & Per-Collective Last-Arrival-Time Straggler Detection

workload.cluster_scale: 10,240-GPU H100/B200 Synchronous Pretraining Cluster ($25,600/hr cluster value, 3.20s nominal step)
workload.grey_failure_profile: 18 runtime sub-health grey failures/week (thermal clock throttle to 1.15GHz, PCIe Gen5->Gen3 downgrade, or optical FEC retry micro-stalls causing +45% single-rank slowdown without crashing)
workload.lockstep_amplification: In synchronous DP/PP/TP, 1 GPU slowing down by 45% stalls all 10,239 healthy peers at every collective barrier

tiers.name: Tier 1: 被动死等最慢卡 (仅靠 30分钟 NCCL 超时 -> 1 张亚健康慢卡拖慢全场 10,239 张好卡)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Unmitigated Lockstep Waiting (30-Min NCCL Timeout Only -> 68.4% Goodput)
tiers.attribution_and_mitigation: No sub-second arrival-time telemetry; straggler never trips 30-min timeout so job crawls at +45% step time
tiers.cluster_impact: Takes ~4.5 hours of manual investigation per grey failure while 10,239 GPUs sit 31% idle at barriers
tiers.recommended_for: None; unacceptable in >=256-GPU synchronous training due to 10,000x barrier amplification.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 粗粒度步长看门狗杀作业重拉 (发现变慢即 Kill 全场万卡 + 退回 Checkpoint 重跑)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Step-Time Watchdog Kill-and-Restart (22.5 Min Rollback + Re-Init per Event)
tiers.attribution_and_mitigation: Triggers global job abort when step time > +15% for 20 steps, cordons node, and restarts from storage
tiers.cluster_impact: Eliminates multi-hour drag, but 18 global restarts/week waste 6.75 hours of 10,240-GPU rollback & warmup
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy training frameworks lacking elastic microbatch rebalancing or warm-spare RDMA state cloning.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 毫秒级到达时间戳归因 (区分慢卡与受害卡) + 动态 DP 微批削减调平 (零重启降载续跑)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: 2.8s Collective Arrival Attribution + Dynamic DP Microbatch Load Shedding
tiers.attribution_and_mitigation: Compares CUDA compute time vs NCCL barrier arrival time to pinpoint the 1 root straggler in 2.8s, then shifts 25-40% of its DP microbatches to healthy peers
tiers.cluster_impact: Zero job restart! Immediately restores 95%+ step speed in-place while awaiting scheduled maintenance
tiers.recommended_for: Immediate software-only deployment on any FSDP/DP training cluster without warm standby nodes.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 内核/硬件联合归因 + 动态微批缓冲 + 4.2秒热备节点 RDMA 零重算热替换 (Live Node Swap)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: 1.5s Telemetry Attribution + Dynamic Shedding + 4.2s Live Warm-Standby RDMA Swap
tiers.attribution_and_mitigation: Fuses CUPTI/NCCL arrival skew with NVML/PCIe/IB counters (1.5s) -> sheds microbatches -> clones 14.2GB FSDP shard from peer over 400G RDMA into warm spare in 4.2s
tiers.cluster_impact: Zero lost training steps & zero checkpoint rollback! Swaps out grey-failing GPU in 4.2s at step boundary
tiers.recommended_for: 1,024–100,000 GPU frontier AI factories demanding >98% Goodput and zero-restart immunity to grey failures.
